description: The plot illustrates Recall@50 and NDCG@50 values across a range of values on the x-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Recall@50” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5 with tick labels at each integer value. The primary y-axis, on the left, is labeled “Recall@50” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.30 to 0.60 with tick labels at 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, 0.45, 0.50, 0.55, and 0.60. The secondary y-axis, on the right, is labeled “NDCG@50” and has a linear scale ranging from 0.15 to 0.22 with tick labels at 0.15, 0.17, 0.19, 0.21, and 0.22. A green line with triangle markers represents Recall@50 (Ours), starting at approximately 0.34 at x=1 and increasing to approximately 0.48 at x=5. A blue solid line represents NDCG@50 (Ours), beginning at approximately 0.17 at x=1 and rising to approximately 0.19 at x=5. A blue dashed line represents NDCG@50 (ReFICR), starting at approximately 0.16 at x=1 and remaining relatively constant at approximately 0.16 at x=5.
